narrative.title: Left-Wing-First Security Sweep
narrative.scenario: An airport's terminal is split into two concourses joined at a central hub. The inspection team's protocol is strict: clear every gate in the left concourse before stamping the hub checkpoint, then sweep the right concourse. Inside any concourse the same protocol repeats recursively. The stamped order of checkpoints is the sweep's official record.
narrative.inputFormat: The root of a binary tree given as a level-order array where null marks a missing child.
narrative.outputFormat: Return an array of node values in inorder: visit the left subtree, then the node, then the right subtree.

testCases.explanation: Left subtree {4,2,5} yields 4,2,5; then root 1; then right subtree {3,6}.
With no children, the single node is recorded in its own turn.

hintLevels: Level 1: Inorder sandwiches the parent between its two subtrees — left wing, then self, then right wing.
Level 2: Swap the recording beat to the middle of the recursion: recurse left, record node, recurse right.
Level 3: For a BST this order surfaces sorted values — a useful sanity check when reasoning about the traversal.
